newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat does not trade in firming market.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat does not trade in firming market.

text.p: Australian wheat futures did not trade on Wednesday as the last of the holiday season lingered and as large commitments of wheat to the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) focused grain trading attention on the pool.
Sydney Futures Exchange settlement prices mostly firmed.

Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said so much wheat had been committed to the AWB that end-users such as flour mills and feed lots were looking to have to buy from the pool at about A$185.00 a tonne.
Futures were edging up toward that level, he said.
Lack of trades in the market was mainly because many farmers and brokers were still on holidays, even though there were some orders in the market.
Activity was expected to pick up next week, he said.
